contexts.markdownDescription:
Kinds of symbols that can name an event

A comma-separated list of the [symbol contexts](https://doc.log10x.com/run/transform/symbol/#contexts) that can name an event. The default `log,exec` matches text passed to a logging call in source code and text read from a program file, such as the output of `strings`. Order in the list does not matter. (Default: log,exec)

maxLen.markdownDescription:
Longest name, in characters

The longest name to write, in characters. Set `0` for no limit. (Accepts number or string with $= prefix for runtime evaluation) (Default: 120)

field.markdownDescription:
Field that holds the name

The field that holds each event's name. The shipped configuration sets `message_pattern`.  The name comes from the [symbolSequence](https://doc.log10x.com/api/js/#TenXObject+symbolSequence) function. (Default: symbolMessage)

hashField.markdownDescription:
Field that holds a hash of the name

The field that holds an 11-character hash of the name. Unset by default.  The hash is [TenXString.hash](https://doc.log10x.com/api/js/#TenXString.hash) of the name: xxHash64 of its UTF-8 bytes, big-endian, in base64url without padding. Any tool can compute the same value, so it works as a join key, a metric tag or a forwarder filter.  Metrics and aggregation carry the hash whether or not this option is set. Events sent back to a [log forwarder](https://doc.log10x.com/run/input/forwarder/) return as they arrived; set this option to add the hash to them, for example `symbolMessageHashField tenx_hash`.

originField.markdownDescription:
Field that holds the statement's source location

The field that holds where the statement is in code, such as `recommendation_server.py:ListRecommendations`. Unset by default.  The value comes from the [symbolOrigin](https://doc.log10x.com/api/js/#TenXObject+symbolOrigin) function. (Default: )

skeletonField.markdownDescription:
Field that holds the message layout

The field that holds the message with `~` in place of each word of the name and `$` in place of each value. Unset by default.  A viewer holding the name and this field can print the line as it was written, punctuation and spacing included, without access to the logs.

messageNegators.markdownDescription:
Line starts that mark a continuation line

Line starts that mark a line as a continuation of the event above it, such as a stack frame. Empty by default. The shipped configuration lists:  - a space, a tab or a literal `\t`: any indented line; - `Caused by: ` and `Suppressed: `: Java chained exceptions; - `--- End of `: the .NET inner exception marker; - `created by `: the Go goroutine creator; - `#0 ` to `#5 `: PHP stack frames.  A continuation line that arrives as its own event is named by its shape, `template_` plus a hash, and not from the symbol library. The [group](https://doc.log10x.com/run/initialize/group/) module keeps such a line with the event above it, even when it holds a level word such as `info`.
